option_relations.rationale: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) and cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation are manifestations or complications of an acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure.
Malignant arrhythmia or conduction system abnormality can be a complication of severe hypoxemia and respiratory failure, which is the consequence of an acute exacerbation of COPD.
The option 'Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure' is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf 'Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure'.
The option 'Acute COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure' is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf 'Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure'.
